_note: Fairest reference comp per matched shot. interaction_feed is deliberately absent: nothing in the official set shows peaceful player-creature interaction, so forcing a comp would produce a dishonest comparison.
_no_reuse: Each shot must use a DISTINCT reference image. r08 used pw_11 for both vista_golden and overshoulder_meadow; the critic spotted that the two 'A' images were identical, which leaks information across pairs — if one is known to be the real game, so is the other. overshoulder_meadow now uses pw_10, which the curator named the cleanest over-shoulder framing in the set.
